description:
Nanga is the B2B marketing analytics platform built by Spark (Paris), used by e-commerce and lead generation companies to follow their advertising, creative and SEO performance.

This connector gives ChatGPT read-only access to your existing Nanga account, for one company chosen when you connect, under your own Nanga permissions. Ask ChatGPT about your advertising: spend, ROAS, CPA and the other metrics your company defines, computed with your own definitions; what moved between two periods and which campaign or platform carries a deterioration; whether data really landed for every platform before you compare; how the account is doing over a period against the previous one; where you stand among comparable companies, anonymously; and what your online store collected next to advertising spend. ChatGPT can also read your saved dashboard analyses and your company context.

Figures are computed by Nanga, not by ChatGPT, and every answer carries its dates, units and definitions. A metric Nanga cannot compute for your company is named as such, never shown as a zero.

You choose what ChatGPT may read when you connect: company context, recent advertising figures and online store sales are three separate permissions. The connector never writes: it changes no campaign, generates no analysis and creates no account. You can revoke access at any time from your Nanga account or from ChatGPT.

An existing Nanga account is required, and your company must have the connector enabled by the Nanga team.

defaultPrompt: What dashboards do I have saved?
My ad spend over the last 30 days
